subtitle: UPDATE Aug 18, 47 days from the first round and on the THIRD DAY OF THE OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN. ⛔ NO NEW PRICE, AND THE REASON IS THE FINDING OF THE DAY: the AFOS capture guard ran FIVE times between 8:30 PM and 9:37 PM and blocked all five. The panel keeps the confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT, and declares below the range each contract was read in tonight. NO new national poll: the latest is still BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, TSE registration BR-03317/2026). Datafolha and Veritá publish on Aug 21, both already in the field, and Datafolha is the first to measure Pablo Marçal.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 64.50% (vol USD 8.52M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT (9:48 PM UTC). POLL: 41% in the first round and 47% in the runoff in today's BTG/Nexus.
fortes: Today's BTG/Nexus puts him at 41% in the first round, up 1 point against the same house's previous round, which had him at 40%.
In the stimulated runoff he appears with 47% against 44%, a result IDENTICAL to the house's previous round, keeping the 3-point advantage.
The distance to the runner-up in the poll stays at 5 points, the same as the previous round, meaning the challenger's gain did not shorten the measured interval.
In the price he remains far ahead, at 64.50% against 31.45%, and his contract holds USD 8.52M inside a presidential book of USD 126.85M.
Of the 90 days in the series recorded since May 19, only 5 are above today's close.
fracos: 🔴 A 2.00pp DROP in the price in one day, from 66.50% to 64.50%, giving back exactly what he had gained the day before.
The distance to the runner-up in the price CLOSED from 37.05pp to 33.05pp, that is 4.00pp in about 26 hours.
The government assessment in today's BTG/Nexus has 42% rating it bad or terrible against 34% excellent or good, with 23% average.
⛔ No upside superlative applies: the series high remains 66.50%, from Aug 1, and today's value sits below it.

The Federal Police found a message in which his son and a lobbyist under investigation for INSS fraud discuss business, and the runner-up and his brother used the case the same day, according to Poder360.
candidates.analise: ⛔ THERE WAS NO CERTIFIED PRICE TODAY, and that is the record of the day. The capture guard ran five times between 8:30 PM and 9:37 PM and blocked all five. Across the ten readings of that window he appeared at 63.50% in ALL of them, with 0.00pp of amplitude, the most stable contract in the book. But the guard certifies the whole capture or none of it, and other contracts disagreed, so the panel keeps the confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT. 📌 POLLS: no new national one. BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 remains the latest, with 41% in the first round and 47% in the runoff, and the distance to the runner-up unchanged at 5 points. In STATE polls today he trails in Paraná, 35% to 52% in the runoff, and leads in Pernambuco, 58% to 24%. State polls do not enter the national panel and are here as coverage. 📅 Datafolha and Veritá publish on Aug 21, both already in the field.

fortes: 🔴 A 2.00pp RISE in the price in one day, from 29.45% to 31.45%, and it is the fourth straight day of gains.

His campaign spent the day in a dispute with a rival from his own side: he accused Caiado of helping the leader, after Kassab said Caiado has zero chance, and Kassab replied that his campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 4.05% (vol USD 9.95M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT (9:48 PM UTC). POLL: 4% in the first round in today's BTG/Nexus, BEHIND Caiado, who has 5%.
fortes: He still leads the first-round third place contract, at 52.50%, the highest probability in that book.
His contract has the LARGEST accumulated volume in the presidential book, at USD 9.95M, above the leader's own.
Today's BTG/Nexus keeps him at 4% in the first round, the same level as recent national polls.
He opened his campaign in São Paulo on Aug 16 with a security-focused speech, according to O Globo and G1.
He publicly assessed that Pablo Marçal's possible entry into the race would benefit his rival on the right, and not him.
fracos: 🔴 A CONTINUED DROP in the price, from 4.70% to 4.05%, and the value sits BELOW any close recorded in the 90-day series, whose floor was 4.80%.
⚠️ His book is thin and swung between 3.75% and 4.15% in under ten minutes during today's capture. The published number is the one the guard confirmed, and that instability is declared here.
In the third place contract he also gave ground, from 53.00% to 52.50%, and the distance to the second name in that book narrowed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
🔴 IN THE POLL HE IS BEHIND CAIADO: today's BTG/Nexus gives Caiado 5% and him 4%.
His series high is 17.90%, from Jun 9, meaning today's price is less than a quarter of that value.
candidates.analise: ⛔ NO CERTIFIED PRICE TODAY, and his behaviour separates two things. In the PRESIDENTIAL contract he sat still at 3.95% across the ten readings of the night, with 0.00pp of amplitude. In the PLACEMENT contracts he moved: 0.35pp in the second place one and 0.50pp in the third place one, where he was read between 56.50% and 57.00%. 📏 The low of the 88-day series was touched on Aug 18, at 3.60%, against a high of 17.90% on Jun 9. 📌 THE DISAGREEMENT WITH THE BALLOT BOX CONTINUES: BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 gives Caiado 5% and him 4%, while the market keeps him far ahead in the third place contract, 57.00% against 37.00%. These are different questions: the poll measures declared intention, the contract measures probability of placement.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE for the whole pack, confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT (9:48 PM UTC): Caiado 0.25% (vol USD 6.07M), Zema 0.25% (vol USD 5.62M). ⭐ Pablo Marçal appears at 0.90% (vol USD 1.21M) and is a registered candidate campaigning under an injunction, though INELIGIBLE until 2032 and with his registration still pending before the electoral court.
candidates.subtitle: Aug 16, first day of campaigning: all three opened their schedules, and in the price all three fell. The crossing that matters is about CONTRACTS, because Caiado goes down on victory and up on placing.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 0.60% (vol USD 5.92M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.45pp | first-round third place at 37.50% | polling in force: Quaest 4%, Gerp 4%, Meio/Ideia 5.7%, BTG/Nexus 5% | REJECTION of 35% in the Quaest of Aug 14
caiado.fortes: ⭐ His THIRD-PLACE contract stands at 37.50%, against 31.00% at the Aug 12 close, a 6.50pp rise with four straight higher closes. In other words, the market moved him closer on PLACING while moving him away from VICTORY. In the polling he still has 4% in the Quaest of Aug 14 and the lowest rejection in the field, 35%. He opened the campaign with a mass at the Goiânia cathedral and a motorcade through Goiás and the Federal District outskirts, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1, and said the United States does not rule Brazil, according to Times Brasil.
caiado.fracos: In the victory price he fell 0.45pp and moved to 0.60%, brushing the 0.5% cutoff. ⚠️ The 35% rejection comes with high name-recognition gaps declared by the house itself, and low rejection with high unfamiliarity is not acceptance: it means most of the electorate has not yet formed an opinion, and an unformed opinion can go either way. His contrast remains the widest on the panel, with 4% to 5.7% of declared intention against less than 1% of victory price.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly 0.05% (vol USD 7.09M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.10pp and below the 0.5% cutoff
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume remains larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading depth despite the floor-level price. He spoke at the president's campaign-opening rally in the ABC region, according to O Globo.
haddad.fracos: ⭐ The caveat the panel had been repeating as an inference became a DATED FACT on Aug 16: he formally opened a campaign for the GOVERNORSHIP OF SÃO PAULO, according to O Globo and Times Brasil. That is, he is not a presidential candidate, and any presidential scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way. No national poll in the window tests him. The price fell to 0.05%, and variation in that band carries no informational value.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly 0.15% (vol USD 5.49M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.20pp and below the 0.5% cutoff | first-round third place at 5.00%
zema.fortes: The Quaest of Aug 14 keeps him at 2% in the first round, the same value as Aug 5, and BTG/Nexus's 3% and Meio/Ideia's 2.6% still stand. He was the first of the chasing pack to file with the electoral court, on Aug 6. He opened the campaign with a mass in Montes Claros, in northern Minas Gerais, promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Valor Econômico.
zema.fracos: 🔴 The Quaest firmness crosstab released on Aug 15 shows he has the LEAST CONVINCED electorate in the field, according to G1, which speaks to how solid his support is rather than how large. In the price he fell 0.20pp and moved to 0.15%, below the 0.5% cutoff. In the third-place contract he has 5.00%, far behind the 53.00% of the chasing pack's leader.

candidates.analise: ⛔ NO CERTIFIED PRICE TODAY. Caiado was STABLE at 0.45% across the ten presidential readings, and swung 0.50pp in the third place contract, between 37.00% and 37.50%. 🏷️ PABLO MARÇAL was the MOST UNSTABLE contract of the night: read between 0.65% and 1.15%, that is 0.50pp of amplitude on a contract worth about 1%, nearly half its own value. A thin book moves on little money, so high amplitude there is market depth and NOT an electoral signal. 📄 ELECTORAL STATUS, updated today: Marçal asked the electoral court to correct his asset declaration, and the declared wealth fell from R$ 7.4 billion to R$ 149.9 million, according to G1, Valor and O Globo, which belong to the same group and therefore count as one source. He remains INELIGIBLE until 2032, with campaigning allowed by injunction and registration still pending. Tarcísio remains a candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo and Haddad for governor of São Paulo, and their contracts stay in the book priced at the floor.
fortes: ⭐ CAIADO ROSE IN THE POSITION CONTRACT: first-round third place went from 37.50% to 38.50%, and his distance to the leader of that book closed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
In today's BTG/Nexus Caiado has 5% in the first round, ABOVE Renan Santos's 4%, inverting the ordering the market prices.
Zema has 4% in the same BTG/Nexus, tied with Renan Santos inside the 2pp margin.
The runner-up's campaign treated Caiado as a problem on the same day: Kassab said the campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.

Pablo Marçal is priced at 0.90%, with USD 1.21M accumulated, and will be included in the Datafolha survey scheduled for Aug 21, according to Valor Econômico. 🏷️ He filed for registration and is among the 13 who did so, and an injunction cleared him to campaign, but he is INELIGIBLE until 2032 and the registration remains pending a decision by the electoral court, according to BBC, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo.
fracos: 🔴 Caiado FELL in the win contract, from 0.60% to 0.25%, below the 0.50% floor recorded in the 90-day series.
Zema remains at 0.25%, below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise.
Both win contracts in the pack sit at a level where a one-hundredth change already shifts the relative percentage, and the panel treats that as shape, not signal.
Kassab, who is the running mate on Caiado's ticket, publicly said he has zero chance in the election, and then said he had been misinterpreted, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão.
Zema opened the week promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, and that still has no translation into price, with 4.95% in the third place contract.

cruzamento: ⭐ THE FINDING OF THE DAY IS NOT A PRICE, IT IS THE REFUSAL TO CERTIFY ONE. The AFOS capture guard takes two readings 8 minutes apart and only clears them if they agree within 0.20pp. It ran FIVE times between 8:30 PM and 9:37 PM BRT on Aug 18 and blocked all five. That is why the panel publishes NO new price: it keeps the confirmed reading of Aug 17, 6:48 PM BRT, and declares here what was read. 🔑 THE PART THAT MATTERS IS WHERE THE INSTABILITY SAT. Across the ten readings of the night the leader came in at 63.50% EVERY time, with 0.00pp of amplitude, and Renan Santos at 3.95% and Ronaldo Caiado at 0.45% did not move either. What blocked certification were the thin contracts and the placement ones: the runner-up ranged between 32.45% and 32.75%, and PABLO MARÇAL ranged between 0.65% and 1.15%, that is 0.50pp of amplitude on a contract worth about 1%, nearly half its own value. In the second place book the runner-up swung 1.00pp, and in the third place book Renan and Caiado swung 0.50pp each. ⚠️ WHAT THIS MEANS AND WHAT IT DOES NOT: a thin book moves on little money, so high amplitude there is NOT an electoral signal, it is market depth. The panel records the difference instead of publishing a number that two readings do not confirm. 📌 POLLS: nothing new. The latest national one is BTG/Nexus of Aug 17, which measured STABILITY, with the distance between the top two at the same 5 points and the runoff identical at 47 to 44. Thursday and Friday change that: Real Time Big Data on Aug 19, Datafolha and Veritá on Aug 21, and Datafolha is the FIRST to include Pablo Marçal, who today has a price in the market and no ballot-box measurement at all.
